mapper.select: select mn.*,pro.P_Name as pName,pro.P_Name as projectName,com.C_Name as prPayCName, cifd.cifd_Account as cifdAccount, cifd.cif_Id as keyId from Payment_Receipt mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_ID = mn.Project_Id left join SYS_Company com on com.C_ID = mn.Pr_Pay_C_Id left join Claim_Incoming_Funds_Dtl cifd on cifd.id = mn.cif_Id where mn.id= #{id}
select mn.* from Payment_Receipt mn where mn.Project_Id= #{pId} and mn.Pr_Verify_State=2 and mn.State=7
